articles.title: Defence, digital ties on PM Modi's Jakarta visit agenda
articles.summary: Alpha Trade provides daily trade ideas from SEBI-registered research analysts, assisting users in growing wealth through expert insights. It offers investment ideas focusing on specific stock selections and prevailing sectoral trends. Additionally, Stock Reports Plus delivers comprehensive, all-in-one stock research. These services aim to equip individuals with professional guidance for informed decision-making in the stock market.

articles.title: Hegseth stands up a new drone office with authority on everything from one-way attack drones to ground robots and boats
articles.summary: A new office is being established within the US military to oversee the majority of its drone programs. This entity will wield significant power, shaping the future development, deployment, and strategic use of unmanned aerial systems across all branches. This consolidation aims to streamline drone operations and foster innovation, directly impacting US defence capabilities and technological advancements in modern warfare.

articles.title: Lessons from Op Sindoor: DAC nod to pseudo satellites, air defence systems, jet-based drones
articles.summary: The Defence Ministry has approved significant procurements including pseudo satellites, jet-based drones, and advanced air defence systems. This strategic move aims to modernize the armed forces, incorporating critical lessons learned to enhance India's defence capabilities and operational readiness. The acquisitions underscore a commitment to strengthening national security through technological advancement and addressing future challenges.

articles.title: Between 1849 and 1874, roughly 100,000 Chinese men from Guangdong province were shipped to Peru under contracts they could not read, to work the coastal guano islands and the sugar plantations — and the fusion cuisine their descendants would eventually create is why the city of Lima today has more than 6,000 Chinese-Peruvian restaurants called chifas
articles.summary: Modern South American gastronomy's most cherished fusion cuisine holds a profound origin story. It was remarkably developed by survivors of the brutal 19th-century indentured labour systems. This highlights how extreme historical adversity, including forced labour, unexpectedly spurred significant culinary innovation, shaping a resilient and beloved cultural tradition within the region's diverse food landscape.

articles.title: UNICORN pact: Japanese stealth technology to make Indian Navy warships harder to detect
articles.summary: India and Japan have inked the historic UNICORN (Unified Complex Radio Antenna) agreement, marking their first-ever joint defence co-development project. This landmark collaboration signifies a deepening strategic partnership, focusing on advanced radio antenna technology. The initiative aims to enhance military capabilities for both nations, reflecting a significant stride in bilateral defence cooperation and technological advancement, crucial for regional security dynamics.

articles.title: Messenger: Ex-landlord wants better jail conditions. His ex-tenants would like a word.
articles.summary: Residents reportedly face a 'Sophie's Choice' dilemma: complain about their living conditions and risk lease non-renewal or eviction, even with legal representation. This situation highlights a critical challenge for tenants, where asserting their rights can lead to severe housing insecurity, underscoring the precariousness faced by many in the rental market.
